correctness.rationale: Proved an exact formal generating-function identity via even Hermite series and diagonal Mehler formula; coefficient extraction gives finite Hermite squares. For gamma in [0,1] every coefficient is nonnegative with j=0 at least central binomial/4^m. For gamma outside, m=1 at large x (negative) or asymptotic alternating central-binomial partial sums at x=0 (above 1) give counterexamples. 528 exact symbolic/rational verifier assertions passed from embedded source. No numerical result substituted for infinite proof.
